Name: Fantasy Foxes
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Can't get enough foxes? Same! This mod brings you a few new fantasy foxes to your game. 

All foxes live in the coop (you'll need Extra Animal Configs for this). They will dig up:

-Deerfoxes: solar essence and star shards
-Kitsunes: tea leaves and omni geodes
-Spiritfoxes: Black spiritfoxes will dig up obsidian and void shards, while white spiritfoxes will dig up quartz and solar essences

Assets for the white spiritfox were brorrowed from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/152]Okami Chibiterasu Pet[/url] by DibJib, which seemed to have open perms, and assets for the black spiritfox were borrowed from Pokemon. You might recognize these two!

Enjoy!
